correctness.rationale: Artebani–Dolgachev geometry plus adjunction and Shioda–Tate exhaust exactly 21 negative curves. Four singular-pattern obstructions are necessary/sufficient for negative definite supports. Exact integer Bareiss/Schur enumeration agrees support-by-support with independent forbidden-pattern enumeration (50,165). Exhaustive AGL2(F3) conjugation yields 11 classes with totals as given. Burnside sums 103248 and 64584 agree with direct 239/299 orbit traversals. The q≡2 standard Frobenius is the order-2 determinant-two class fixing 1037 supports; no unproved infinite extrapolation from numerical sampling.

value.rationale: The 21 negative curves form a canonical divisor configuration on the classical extremal rational elliptic Hesse surface. Complete 11-type equivariant classification, 239/299 orbit totals and exact 50,165-versus-1,037 finite-field descent count are nontrivial rational linear-series invariants not implied numerically by the prior geometric count. The distinction between two order-three classes with the same total 26 but different graded vectors illustrates structural content beyond an isolated small example.
